sisi.depan: Towering spools of synthetic fiber are stacked high against the far wall.
sisi.kanan: A side room with frosted glass walls and a single metal door is built into the right wall.
sisi.belakang: A massive, corrugated metal roll-up door, currently closed, serves as the main entrance on the back wall.
sisi.kiri: Thick, grimy pipes of various diameters run vertically up the left wall, venting steam from several nozzles.

atas: The high ceiling is a network of steel rafters and conduits, with a single broken skylight allowing a beam of dusty light to shine down.
